scope: Pre-calibration comparison of a controlled factorial calibration cohort; no independent/global VoiceOver accuracy claim. Exact action sequence collisions with historical cases are preserved in the plan; all current pairs are one connected training group. Native collected for both browsers before any speech-engine change. All planned actions retained. Once inspected, this cohort is regression. Hint candidate equality is not speech queue behavior; state transitions verify prediction inputs rather than whole-engine State Accuracy.

plan.scope: Controlled button state calibration: same native HTML and handler, attributes vary pressed absent/false/mixed and expanded absent/false; physical Space changes and reverse return. All connected pairs remain calibration. Require Native role/state audit before declaring input equivalence; existing button/checkbox verifier does not yet independently measure pressed/expanded. No independent/global accuracy claim.
metrics: conditional eligible speech and all-plan match rates
plan.inputEquivalence: Retain every planned row. Require independently visible unique geometry candidate, matching AX target role/name, pressed/expanded state, AXCustomContent/AXHelp and before/after state changes. Existing verifier is incomplete for these new states; withhold eligibility until an independently sourced AX state audit; retain unverified/unstable target or ancestor context as unknown. Keyboard focus alone does not prove a reading target.
plan.attribution: Existing wire-request-v1 bounded-window quality check; no native speech-completion guarantee. Predict before Native collection; never feed observed speech or target corrections into predictions.
plan.failurePolicy: No engine or input changes until both browsers finish. Inspected cohort becomes regression. No Navigation or Task Success claim. Native checked-state transition observations verify speech inputs, not whole-engine State Accuracy.
plan.mainPolicy: Existing normalized Main Speech plus case/punctuation-preserving whitespace-only exact diagnostic. Help prefix classification requires actual observed AXHelp, never predicted help.
plan.fullPolicy: Literal main/hint candidate equality; candidate is not a queue scheduler. Keep missing/repeated hints distinct from main wording and preserve raw receipts.

inputAudit.reason: Initial verifier did not measure pressed/expanded. This audit uses raw Native AX subrole/value/expanded attributes and before/after state, with missing attributes retained as unmeasured. Frozen model predictions and inputs are unchanged.
